artifacts.summary: Retried acquisition of 8 standard representation-theorem sources left unacquired by the prior representation-literature research report; recovered Gehrke & Jonsson 2004 (mscand.dk migrated to journals.msp.org) and confirmed, with new source-specific evidence, that the other 7 remain genuinely unacquirable via this pipeline (paywall, bronze-OA-but-403, authenticated-only mirror, or absent from author homepage).

memory_candidates.content: When an OJS-hosted journal article's old download URL 404s (e.g. an mscand.dk-style host), the journal may have migrated OJS platforms. Follow the article's `view` URL (not `download`) to find the redirect target, then read the new host's `<meta name="citation_pdf_url">` tag for a working, often unauthenticated, PDF endpoint. This recovered a source (Gehrke & Jonsson 2004, Math. Scand. 94) that a prior research pass had marked not-acquired due to a stale download URL.

literature-ingest-online.sh's automated Zotero-write (create-item) path can fail with ONLINE_INGEST_ZOTERO_CREATE_FAILED due to a zotero-cli-cc/pyzotero/httpx2 dependency bug (`TypeError: 'httpx.Timeout' object cannot be interpreted as an integer or float`), independent of source availability. Workaround: once the PDF is downloaded and magic-byte-verified, bypass the bridge's Zotero step and feed the file directly to the unmodified literature-ingest.sh (convert/chunk/index), then hand-patch index.json/specs/literature-index.json metadata to match the schema of existing entries. The document has no zotero_key/zotero_path in this case.

Unpaywall's oa_status: "bronze" classification (is_oa: true but best_oa_location.url_for_pdf is null) means the publisher currently allows free reading on its own page, but there is no stable, directly downloadable PDF URL, and a non-browser curl fetch of the derived PDF endpoint (e.g. ScienceDirect's /pii/<id>/pdf pattern) returns HTTP 403 (bot/TDM challenge). Treat bronze differently from gold/green/hybrid OA when planning automated literature acquisition: it is not machine-acquirable via this pipeline's curl-based tooling even though it is nominally free-to-read.

next_steps: Run /plan 504 to decide whether any further action is warranted (e.g. patching the zotero-cli-cc dependency, or accepting the remaining 7 sources as permanently unacquired via this pipeline), or fold the acquired gehrke_jonsson_2004 source directly into a revision of the representation section.
